criteria.criterion_text: Explain the relationship between front-end and back-end development by providing an example that demonstrates how the two components interact in practice.

Explain the application of appropriate website design practices, supported by relevant evidence of work, and distinguish between their role in programming and their role in search engine optimization (SEO).
Create a minimum of three linked web pages considering layout structure, user requirement and decent design principles.
Discuss the challenges might be faced during the building stage of website design.
Describe CSS specificity in selectors, demonstrating with relevant examples how it affects design behavior and provide best practice to consider the specificity.
Apply responsive practices in a design with describing the role of each practice.
Create a suitable documentation for a design which can be well-informed by other developers.
Compare between inline and block elements regarding their behavior and default computed styling.
Analyze the purpose of using legacy browser compatibility practices in HTML and CSS detailing the consequences of not implementing them.
Analyze the importance of UI/UX design as a preliminary stage of frontend development, detailing the challenges faced by developers when no defined UI is available as a reference.
Analyze user feedback on a design with detailing the modifications applied to improve the project regarding code structure, design principles and best practices.
Justify the purpose of creating a documentation for project code.
Evaluate the use of coding standards and commenting practices, assessing their impact on teamwork and code readability, supported by relevant examples.
Evaluate a website design and validate its code using W3C standards.
Evaluate the role of JavaScript in website development, demonstrating a clear understanding of its function in creating dynamic websites.
